questions.scenario: In a coordinate plane, two points A and B have position vectors a = i + 2j and b = 5i + 4j relative to the origin O.
questions.question: Find the position vector of P.
marking_criteria: Correct calculation of the position vector of P
Correct application of the section formula
Correct notation
hints: Use the section formula for internal division.
questions.model_answer: Position vector of P = a + (3/4)AB = (i + 2j) + (3/4)(4i + 2j) = i + 2j + 3i + (3/2)j = 4i + (7/2)j
questions.explanation: To find the position vector of P, use the section formula for internal division.
